# About the Manufactured Homes Registry category

_Category: Manufactured Homes Registry · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**maribeth.wilson** (11/25/2025):

**MHR**
The Manufactured Homes Registry (MHR) maintains a central register of manufactured home ownership details and controls the movement of manufactured homes in B.C.

MHR improves the security of lenders in financing purchases of manufactured homes.
